content.short: zk.Link is a ZK Aggregated Layer 3 connecting thousands of blockchains and rollups into one unified liquidity and settlement layer.
content.description: zk.Link is building a ZK-powered aggregated Layer 3 infrastructure that connects multiple blockchains and rollups including Mantle into a single, unified trading and settlement environment. Using zero-knowledge proofs, zk.Link aggregates liquidity from dozens of chains, enabling users to trade across chains with unified account balances while solving the cross-chain liquidity fragmentation problem at the infrastructure level through rollup aggregation.
